en.arm.raw.gloss: The same metrics, logs, and traces stored in GreptimeDB tables, queried through read-only SQL and PromQL.
en.arm.raw.name: GreptimeDB
en.arm.semantic_graph.gloss: The Raw interface plus table semantics, entities, and source-proven relationships.
en.arm.semantic_graph.name: GreptimeDB + Semantic Graph
en.arm.split_pillars.gloss: Prometheus, Loki and Tempo, each through its own API and query language. No query can join signals across them.
en.arm.split_pillars.name: Three backends
en.board.note: Each confirmatory family is Holm-corrected on its own. Non-significant means insufficient evidence, not equivalence.
en.board.title: Three questions, and what the measurement supports
en.cases.lede: Cases use opaque IDs in agent input. Reference mechanisms and targets appear only in the report, not in the prompt.
en.cases.title: Cases and per-case outcomes
en.component.read-only-sql: Read-only SQL over all three signals
en.component.telemetry: The incident's metrics, logs and traces
en.cost.lede: Costs cover all runs included for each interface, including failed runs. Archived retry attempts are reported separately. Ratios compare each interface with the lowest-cost interface for the same model.
en.cost.not_estimable: Complete cost is not estimable from the reported usage and frozen rates
en.cost.title: Estimated end-to-end cost by interface
en.diagnosis.lede: Out of {runs} runs per model and interface. Descriptive only: diagnosis accuracy is not a pre-specified endpoint.
en.diagnosis.title: Did the interface change how often the diagnosis was right?
en.footer.cta_note: One database for metrics, logs and traces.
en.footer.text: Generated deterministically from sanitized measurement artifacts. It embeds no provider payloads, raw telemetry, credentials or endpoints.
en.glossary.arms.def: Split uses three native backend APIs; Raw uses GreptimeDB SQL and PromQL; Graph adds the semantic interface to Raw.
en.glossary.delta.def: The comparison named in the heading. A negative delta means the interface named first used less.
en.glossary.eligible.def: A case with at least one repetition pair where both runs have a correct diagnosis, a citation to a successful non-truncated query, no runner error, and no budget exhaustion.
en.glossary.holm.def: The p value after multiplicity correction within one confirmatory family.
en.glossary.median.def: Repetition deltas are reduced to one median per model and case before any cross-case summary.
en.glossary.na.def: Not estimable. It never means zero.
en.glossary.run.def: One model, one incident, one interface, one repetition.
en.headline.cost.note: lower is better; includes failed runs retained in the report
en.headline.input_tokens.note: lower is better; workload total over every run, not the pre-specified endpoint
en.headline.lede: Each row compares the same models and incidents under the same tool budget. Ratios use the best interface in that row as the denominator. These aggregate results are descriptive.
en.headline.title: Results by interface
en.hero.board.note: Ratios use the best interface in each column as the denominator. Cost intervals are shown in USD when an exact estimate is unavailable. Higher accuracy is better; lower cost and input are better.
en.hero.board.title: Three interfaces, same incidents
en.hero.eyebrow: Paired agent benchmark · GreptimeDB Semantic Graph
en.hero.models.note: {runs} runs per interface. Models are ordered by total correct diagnoses.
en.hero.models.title: Correct diagnoses by model
en.interface.lede: The pre-specified endpoints are complete-run tool calls and provider-visible input tokens, compared only in eligible pairs. Diagnosis accuracy is reported separately.
en.interface.rows_note: Rows returned cannot be compared here. A Prometheus sample, a Loki entry and a Tempo trace are not the same unit as a GreptimeDB row, so rows returned reports N/A against the three-backend bundle instead of zero.
en.interface.title: GreptimeDB against Prometheus, Loki and Tempo
en.method.evidence_note: The deterministic verifier evaluates SQL evidence. This separate audit does not select the headline efficiency sample.
en.method.rejection_note: The verifier runs its mechanism check over every citation, including ones submitted as exclusion or downstream-impact evidence that never claimed to prove the mechanism. Only the first column describes an attempt that fell short; the second only shows how wide the check reaches. A code in either column does not by itself mean a claim failed, because another citation may already ground it.
en.method.title: Method and limits
en.metric.correct_completion_tool_calls.not: tool calls across the complete run; efficiency comparisons require eligible pairs
en.metric.rows_returned.note: rows returned by the agent’s queries
en.models.score_note: A descriptive index computed after the measurement, out of {max} points split {split} between location, root cause and executed evidence. Scores are normalised to 100 over each model's {runs} end-to-end runs, with failed runs left in the denominator. It is not a pre-specified endpoint and carries no significance test.
en.models.title: How the models differed
en.overview.evidence_note: Pre-specified tests were frozen in a hashed Git protocol, not a public registry. Significance requires Holm-adjusted p < {alpha}; other results are descriptive.
en.overview.setup_lede: Each model investigates each incident {total} times: {repetitions} repetitions for each of {interfaces} interfaces. Telemetry, the incident, the investigation method, the diagnosis contract, and the tool budget are fixed. Interface-specific instructions describe store operations.
en.panel.caveats: Scope and limits of this finding
en.panel.confound: Open the same runs split by source dataset
en.panel.evidence: Open evidence pairing and claim rejection codes
en.panel.matrix: Open the exact component list for each interface
en.panel.scores: Open exact scores and the rubric
en.panel.strips: Every case behind these medians, and the significance test
en.pricing.rate_unit: Rates are in the listed currency per million tokens.
en.pricing.title: Pricing and exchange rates
en.question.model_ranking: How do the models differ at RCA under each interface?
en.question.semantic_layer: Does Semantic Graph reduce investigation work compared with Raw?
en.question.storage_shape: Does GreptimeDB's unified interface reduce investigation work compared with Prometheus, Loki, and Tempo?
en.relative.lede: Each bar shows the median relative resource difference across eligible cases, after taking the median within each case’s eligible repetition pairs.
en.relative.note: median across eligible cases; descriptive, not a pre-specified endpoint
en.resources.lede: Input includes all provider-visible input tokens, including cached input. Reasoning is included in output and is not counted twice.
en.resources.title: Tokens, cost, and reliability
en.retrieval.discovery.body: Given an incident window and an unknown schema, the model must find the relevant table and signal. Raw provides schema inspection and SQL queries; the semantic interface also supports lookup by signal meaning.
en.retrieval.discovery.title: Discovery: find the signal in an unfamiliar schema
en.retrieval.graph.body: Given an anomalous service signal, the model must identify the relevant direct dependency and cite evidence. Raw can reconstruct relationships from trace spans; the semantic interface exposes source-proven relationships for direct queries.
en.retrieval.graph.title: Graph retrieval: dependency evidence
en.retrieval.interpretation: Lower resource use in a retrieval task does not establish lower resource use across a complete investigation. This measurement does not isolate the contribution of each investigation step.
en.retrieval.lede: Rows and calls are measured through the evidence query. These tasks measure evidence retrieval rather than full root cause diagnosis.
en.retrieval.metric_note: Rows and calls are counted up to the query that returns the evidence, not across a whole investigation, so they do not compare with the end-to-end metrics.
en.retrieval.title: Focused retrieval tasks
en.semantic.lede: Both interfaces query the same telemetry in GreptimeDB. Graph adds the semantic interface to Raw. The pre-specified endpoints are complete-run tool calls and returned rows, compared in eligible pairs.
en.semantic.reversal_lede: Correct diagnoses under each interface, grouped by the level the fault sat at.
en.semantic.title: What the GreptimeDB Semantic Graph changed
en.strip.lede: Each point represents one eligible case. Its position is the median resource difference across that case’s eligible repetition pairs.

zh.arm.raw.gloss: 相同的指标、日志和链路存储在 GreptimeDB 表中，通过只读 SQL 和 PromQL 查询。
zh.arm.raw.name: GreptimeDB
zh.arm.semantic_graph.gloss: 在 Raw 接口上增加表语义、实体和源数据支持的关系。
zh.arm.semantic_graph.name: GreptimeDB + 语义层
zh.arm.split_pillars.gloss: Prometheus、Loki、Tempo 各用自己的 API 和查询语言，无法在一次查询里关联多种信号。
zh.arm.split_pillars.name: 三个后端
zh.board.note: 两个确认性检验族各自独立做 Holm 校正。不显著表示证据不足，不表示等价。
zh.board.title: 三个问题，以及测量支持的结论
zh.cases.lede: Agent 输入使用不透明的 case ID；参考答案中的机制与目标只在报告中展示，不写入提示词。
zh.cases.title: Case 与逐 case 结果
zh.component.read-only-sql: 覆盖三种信号的只读 SQL
zh.component.semantic-relationships: 源数据支持的依赖关系
zh.component.telemetry: 该故障的指标、日志与链路
zh.cost.billed_in: 按 {currency} 计费，此处显示美元
zh.cost.lede: 成本覆盖各接口纳入报告的全部运行，包括失败运行；归档重试开销另列。倍数为该接口成本除以同一模型下成本最低的接口，仅用于模型内部比较。
zh.cost.not_estimable: 无法根据返回的用量和冻结价格完整估算成本
zh.cost.title: 各接口的端到端估算成本
zh.diagnosis.lede: 每个模型和接口各 {runs} 次 run。仅作描述：诊断正确率不是预先指定端点。
zh.diagnosis.title: 接口是否改变了诊断的正确率？
zh.footer.cta_note: 指标、日志、链路，一个数据库。
zh.footer.text: 本页由脱敏测量工件确定性生成，不含模型服务原始响应、原始遥测行、凭据或服务端点。
zh.glossary.arms.def: Split 使用三套后端的原生 API；Raw 使用 GreptimeDB SQL 和 PromQL；Graph 在 Raw 上增加语义接口。
zh.glossary.delta.def: 按标题给出的比较方向。负数表示排在前面的那种接口用得更少。
zh.glossary.eligible.def: 至少有一组重复配对满足：两侧均诊断正确，引用成功且未截断的查询，无运行器错误，也未耗尽预算。
zh.glossary.holm.def: 在同一确认性检验族内做多重比较校正后的 p 值。
zh.glossary.median.def: 跨 case 汇总前，先在每个模型和 case 内对重复取中位数。
zh.glossary.run.def: 一个模型 × 一个故障 × 一种接口 × 一次重复。
zh.grade.not_confirmed.gloss: 没有预先指定端点通过校正
zh.headline.cost.note: 越低越好；包含纳入报告的失败运行
zh.headline.input_tokens.note: 越低越好；纳入运行的输入总量，不是预先指定端点
zh.headline.lede: 每行比较相同模型、故障和工具预算下的结果；倍数以该行表现最好的接口为分母。这些汇总结果仅作描述。
zh.headline.title: 各接口的结果对比
zh.hero.board.caveat: 描述性汇总，非预先冻结的端点。
zh.hero.board.note: 倍数以每列最优接口为分母；无法完整计价时，成本以美元区间展示。正确诊断越多越好，成本和输入越低越好。
zh.hero.board.title: 三个接口，相同故障
zh.hero.eyebrow: 配对 Agent Benchmark · GreptimeDB Semantic Graph
zh.hero.models.note: 每个接口运行 {runs} 次；按三个接口的正确诊断总数排序。
zh.hero.models.title: 各模型的正确诊断
zh.interface.lede: 预先指定端点为完整运行的工具调用次数和模型服务报告的输入 token，只比较合格配对；诊断正确率另作描述。
zh.interface.rows_note: 返回行数在这里无法比较。Prometheus 的一个 sample、Loki 的一条 entry、Tempo 的一条 trace，和 GreptimeDB 的一行不是同一个单位，因此返回行数在三后端组合下显示 N/A，不是 0。
zh.interface.title: GreptimeDB 对比 Prometheus、Loki 和 Tempo
zh.label.join_calls: 成功的 SQL JOIN 调用
zh.label.join_runs: 含成功 JOIN 的 run
zh.method.evidence_note: 确定性验证器评估 SQL 证据；这项独立审计不决定主要效率样本的入选资格。
zh.method.rejection_note: 验证器会对每一条引用都跑机制检查，包括那些作为排除性证据或下游影响提交、本来就不声称证明机制的引用。只有第一列代表尝试了但没做到，第二列只反映检查的覆盖范围。任一列出现计数都不等于该 claim 失败，因为可能已有另一条引用把它证明了。
zh.method.title: 方法与边界
zh.method.tool_use: Agent 实际使用了哪些接口
zh.metric.correct_completion_tool_calls.not: 统计完整运行的调用次数；效率比较仅纳入合格配对
zh.models.score_note: 测量之后计算的描述性指数，满分 {max}，按 {split} 分配给定位、根因和已执行证据。分数在每个模型的 {runs} 次端到端 run 上归一化到 100，失败的 run 仍计入分母。它不是预先指定端点，也不做显著性检验。
zh.models.title: 模型之间的差异
zh.overview.evidence_note: 预先指定的检验冻结于带哈希的 Git 协议，不是公开注册。显著性要求 Holm 校正后 p < {alpha}；其他结果只作描述。
zh.overview.setup_lede: 每个模型对每个故障调查 {total} 次：{interfaces} 种接口各重复 {repetitions} 次。遥测数据、故障、调查方法、诊断要求和工具预算固定；接口说明分别描述各存储的操作。
zh.panel.caveats: 展开这条结论的口径与边界
zh.panel.confound: 展开同一批 run 按来源数据集的拆分
zh.panel.cost: 展开各接口成本与计价
zh.panel.evidence: 展开证据配对与 claim 拒绝原因
zh.panel.matrix: 展开各接口的完整组件清单
zh.panel.reliability: 展开可靠性与成本合计
zh.panel.scores: 展开精确分数与评分细则
zh.panel.strips: 展开逐 case 结果与显著性检验
zh.panel.tool_calls: 展开完整工具调用明细
zh.pricing.rate_unit: 单价单位为每百万 token，币种见各行。
zh.pricing.title: 定价与汇率说明
zh.pricing.units_per_usd: 每美元对应的计费币种金额
zh.question.model_ranking: 在每种接口下，各模型的 RCA 表现有何差异？
zh.question.semantic_layer: 相比 Raw，Semantic Graph 能否减少调查工作量？
zh.question.storage_shape: 相比 Prometheus、Loki、Tempo，GreptimeDB 一体化接口能否减少调查工作量？
zh.relative.lede: 每条表示合格 case 的资源相对差异中位数；先在每个 case 内对合格重复配对取中位数，再跨 case 汇总。
zh.relative.note: 合格 case 的中位数；描述性指标，非预先指定端点
zh.resources.lede: 输入量包含模型服务报告的全部输入 token，包括缓存输入。推理 token 已计入输出，不重复相加。
zh.resources.title: Token、成本与可靠性
zh.retrieval.discovery.body: 模型需要在未知 schema 中找到指定故障窗口对应的表和信号。Raw 提供元信息探查和 SQL 查询；语义接口还支持按信号含义检索。
zh.retrieval.discovery.title: Discovery：在陌生 schema 里找到信号
zh.retrieval.graph.body: 从给定的服务异常信号出发，模型需要找到相关的直接依赖并引用证据。Raw 可从 trace span 重建关系；语义接口可直接查询源数据支持的关系。
zh.retrieval.graph.title: Graph retrieval：依赖关系与证据检索
zh.retrieval.interpretation: 专项检索中资源用量减少，不能证明完整调查也更省。本次测量没有单独识别各调查步骤的贡献。
zh.retrieval.lede: 行数与调用次数统计到证据查询，测量证据检索的工作量，不覆盖完整根因诊断。
zh.retrieval.metric_note: Rows 和 calls 只统计到返回证据的那条查询为止，不覆盖整个调查过程，因此不能与端到端指标比较。
zh.retrieval.title: 专项检索任务
zh.semantic.lede: 两种接口查询 GreptimeDB 中相同的遥测数据；Graph 在 Raw 上增加语义接口。预先指定端点为完整运行的工具调用次数和返回行数，只比较合格配对。
zh.semantic.mechanism_title: 按故障机制看返回行数
zh.semantic.reversal_lede: 按故障所在层级分组的各接口诊断正确数。
zh.semantic.title: GreptimeDB 语义层改变了什么
zh.strip.lede: 每个点代表一个合格 case，位置表示该 case 内合格重复配对的资源差值中位数。
zh.th.direction: 更少 / 持平 / 更多
zh.th.rejection_other: 被一并检查的其他引用
